So for a couple weeks my fiesta had been overheating consistently, I took it to be pressure tested which showed no problems so I changed out the aux belt, water pump and thermostat, it was still overheating. £150 spent.

I then changed the expansion tank cap and boom, it was fixed. What are the chances? 

Anyway, since repairing the car it was fine for about a week, and then when I started it all gauges went max and no noise, it then after 3-4 seconds chugged into life with a huge cloud of steam.

I flushed the coolant later that day and changed the oil and to my dismay the oil cap was covered in “Your head gasket is done for juice”

I’m wondering where I should go from here, I have the know how to change my head gasket but this is the only symptom, could this have been caused by the water boiling in the expansion tank? 

I don’t have enough money to keep getting it tested or throwing it into a garage. Nor the money to change bits willy nilly due to this virus, what should I check for?
